caption: Exercises to lift a suitcase overhead: the five rung hinge ladder, every rung named with its tier and reps, from Standing Hip Hinge to Single-Leg Hip Thrust, plus Prone Y Raise for the upper back. A chair is the only equipment. Who lifts your bag?

overlays.text: The 5 moves that made lifting my own bag overhead easy.

scenes.footer: Ready for rung 2 when 10 feel easy.

overlays.text: Standing Hip Hinge. 10 reps. Push your hips back, chest forward, stand tall.

scenes.footer: Ready when your back stays flat.

overlays.text: Hinge and Reach. 10 reps. Same hinge, arms reach forward at the bottom.
Single-Leg Hip Hinge. 6 each side. One foot down, hinge, the other leg goes back.

scenes.footer: Ready when you can pause at the top.

overlays.text: Hip Thrust. 10 reps. Shoulders on a chair, feet flat, drive your hips up.

scenes.footer: This is the bag going up.

overlays.text: Single-Leg Hip Thrust. 6 each side. Same thrust, one leg.

scenes.footer: Upper back. It finishes the lift.

overlays.text: Prone Y Raise. 10 reps. Lie on your front, arms in a Y, lift them off the floor.
You put your own bag in the locker. Who lifts yours?
